title: Deep learning on routine chest radiographs assesses major osteoporotic fracture risk
summary: A convolutional neural network survival model was developed in 53,109 adults at a tertiary hospital and externally validated in 85,284 patients from two other institutions. In external validation it reached a C-index of 0.843 (95% CI 0.837-0.850) and a 10-year AUROC of 0.855 (95% CI 0.846-0.863), versus 0.779 and 0.785 for FRAX with BMD. The benefit was greatest in patients with osteopenia. All participants had been referred for densitometry, so absolute-risk and case-finding estimates need prospective evaluation in an unselected population.
